description: This Dart file defines the AuthService class responsible for user authentication operations such as login, registration, user retrieval, and token management, using shared_preferences for local storage and an ApiService for server communication.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling user authentication, token storage, and user session management.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates user with email and password, stores JWT token on success, and fetches current user details.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user with provided credentials, then auto-logs in the user.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's details from the backend.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears stored credentials and tokens, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Checks if the user is currently logged in by verifying the presence of a token.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token from shared preferences.

methods.name: _saveToken
methods.description: Stores the provided token in shared preferences.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the service by loading and setting any stored token.
